interest: Index of Japanese troop movements in East Asia, 1931–38.
overview: This file consists of the U.S. Department of State's official 'List of Papers' docket sheets for decimal file 894.23 (Internal Affairs of Japan: Movement of Troops), spanning November 1931 through November 1938 across serial numbers 1 to 99. The register records diplomatic despatches, consular telegrams, military attaché reports, and State Department memoranda tracking the movements, concentrations, and operations of the Imperial Japanese Army and Navy across East Asia. Because operational intelligence on Japanese military actions was primarily integrated into political reporting on China, virtually all indexed communications were cross-referenced to related State Department files, particularly 793.94 (Sino-Japanese relations) and 893.01 (Manchuria). Key episodes documented in the register include the 1931–1932 Japanese occupation of Manchuria (operations around Chinchow, Tsitsihar, and Harbin), the 1932 Shanghai Incident from initial landings at Woosung through urban combat and phased withdrawal under the Joint Commission, troop concentrations on the Soviet and Outer Mongolian frontiers, and the mobilization and maritime embarkation of Japanese divisions from domestic ports such as Kobe and Hiroshima during the wider Sino-Japanese War in 1938.

subfiles.about: A seven-page State Department docket list (List of Papers) indexing ninety-nine serial items concerning Japanese troop movements and military deployments between November 1931 and November 1938.
subfiles.summary: This document comprises the Department of State's official 'List of Papers' docket register for decimal file 894.23 (Movement of Troops - Japan), recording correspondence and intelligence reports across serials 1 through 99 between November 1931 and November 1938. The register indexes telegrams, despatches, and military attaché reports from diplomatic and consular posts in Tokyo, Peiping, Shanghai, Tientsin, Harbin, and Kobe, almost all of which were cross-referenced to political decimal files 793.94 (Sino-Japanese relations) and 893.01 (Manchuria). Key operations cataloged include the 1931–1932 occupation of Manchuria, the 1932 Shanghai Incident and subsequent urban evacuations witnessed by U.S. officers, troop mobilizations across the Korean railway network, and maritime troop embarkations from Kobe and Hiroshima during the Sino-Japanese War in 1938.
